purpose: Requirements for /forge:start-implement: selecting plan tasks, implementing, reviewing and updating the plan with state preserved across interruptions and errors, and completion confirmed by the orchestrator.
summary: Overview and problems solved: resumable work, orchestrator understanding before delegation, fewer review round trips
Task selection and presentation by priority, task group handling, and skipping waiting or finished tasks
Progress state kept in the plan, written only by the orchestrator, with resume and stale in-progress handling
Error handling: failed state, rerun rules, reverting dependent implemented tasks, one immediate retry
Orchestrator comprehension and preparation before delegating to an executor agent
Completion conditions and final confirmation against acceptance criteria and design/requirement documents
Task groups: build-passing units, single group review, members marked implemented then completed together
Review request and result handling, plan file format (JSON per DES-074), structured data exchange, parallel execution
Executor agent constraints, no edits to design/requirements during implementation, post-completion commit flow
Data formats TaskContext and TaskResult, plus NFR that contract-violating results are never treated as success
tasks: Writing or changing executor agent prompts and constraints
Implementing task selection and plan state updates
Implementing task group build and review flow
Implementing error handling and rerun of failed tasks
title: REQ-034 start-implement 要件定義書
